channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Katayama says G20 should monitor markets with urgency
item.description: The finance minister warned speculators that Japan was prepared to take action in the currency market again if necessary.

item.title: Emergency alert for strong quake withdrawn minutes later
item.description: Initial alerts warned of strong shaking across northern, eastern and central Japan following a quake near the Kuril Islands.

item.title: Japan’s national security strategy could be up for a major overhaul
item.description: All eyes are on how Tokyo will upgrade its three key security documents by the end of the year.

item.title: BOJ’s Koeda warns against too much caution on rate hikes
item.description: The board member reiterated that she didn't have any specific pace in mind for pushing up rates when asked about the possibility of a hike in October.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
